build_pipeline_from_config: build a pipeline from a PipelineConfig with specified num_threads and max_failures parameters
run_pipeline_in_subprocess: run a pipeline in a subprocess and iterate over the results with configurable concurrency
run_pipeline_in_subinterpreter: run a pipeline in a subinterpreter and iterate over results across multiple epochs
get_default_build_callback: get the currently registered default build callback function or None if not set
set_default_build_callback: set a callback function that receives a PipelineConfig before each pipeline is built
